body_lead: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu on Monday directed officials to increase administrative efficiency by leveraging Artificial Intelligence across departments. The chief minister instructed officials to establish a mechanism to integrate data from drones, CCTV cameras and satellite sources effectively to deliver better public services and improve performance. “Naidu directed officials to increase administrative efficiency by leveraging Artificial Intelligence across all departments,” said an official press release.
